description: Gaia schema metadata — single source of truth for nomenclature, theming, and validation rules. Technical policy is documented in META.md.

ultimateFusionCriteria.description: All prerequisites must be named skills. The proposer must hold origin status on at least 1 of them.

types.description: Structural/provenance metadata for composition and rank. Auto-derived for fused/Ultimate skills from suiteComponents; contributes 0 Trust Magnitude and does not count toward Trust Grade diversity.
types.notes: Retained for structural/provenance/rank metadata. A skill with suiteComponents and no fusion-recipe row fails validation; origin counts, nested suites, graph traversal, and Apex predicates remain structural.

types.description: Stars on the skill's own repository, calibrated as direct adoption evidence for its curated skill set.
types.freshness: re-fetch quarterly; no time decay (gaia refresh-stars re-stamps lastVerified)
types.notes: Same-source dedup collapses multiple entries pointing at the same canonical URL to one. Fork-network canonicalization merges forks of the same upstream unless the evidence entry sets links.canonicalRepo. The 250 TM cap is reached at 62.5k stars; stars do not satisfy the independent S-witness gate.

types.description: The skill's artifact is bundled inside a separately-starred external project.
types.notes: Until proxy-containment validator ships, claims count at full magnitude with explicit unverified=true flag. S-capable at 125k+ external stars (RFC §2.4).

types.description: A 4★+ Verifier signs an attestation that the skill is real and graded fairly.
types.freshness: null on derank — evaluates to null (not zero) when attesting Verifier drops below 4★ (RFC §5.6)
types.notes: No cap on verifier count for magnitude. Diversity gate for S counts max 3 verifiers as one distinct type slot. Null-on-derank: the row is removed from TM sum; flag preserved for audit. S-capable at 3+ verifiers.

types.description: A reproducible benchmark on a public dataset, scored as percentile rank within the field.
types.notes: S-capable at 95th+ percentile. Weight 1.4 because percentiles are externally verifiable. Only at 1.4 (not 1.5) because benchmark choice can be cherry-picked.

types.description: Academic citation count for a published paper associated with the skill.
types.notes: S-capable at 500+ citations (artifact_score=100). High citation counts cluster around foundational papers — these legitimately deserve S. S floor is 95 (artifact_score threshold).

types.description: Structured walkthrough with written critique by 4★+ reviewers (distinct from verifier-attestation).
types.notes: S-capable at 3+ distinct reviewers (magnitude=75, weight=1.2, artifact_score≈90). Published NAR/Nature-level peer-reviewed papers with 4★+ reviewers legitimately deserve S. S floor is 88.

types.description: Artifact volume evidence from the contributor's own repository (commits + contributors).
types.notes: B-cap and weight 0.6 ensure repo-own alone cannot carry a skill past B. repo-own is self-produced and cannot serve as the Yggdrasil III S witness; A/B behavior is unchanged.

types.description: Contributor declaration that the skill exists and is real. Flat 10 magnitude, max 1 entry per skill.
types.notes: C-cap. A skill with only self-attestation scores 5 artifact score (10 × 0.5) and lands ungraded. Placeholder for newly-added skills with no external trail yet.

types.description: Creator/audience evidence — video views, engagement, topical authority from external creators.
types.magnitude: log10(views) * 8 * creator_mult * engagement_ratio where engagement_ratio = min(1.5, (likes + comments*5) / views * 50)
types.notes: Hard A-cap (RFC §10.7): social-signal contribution to TM never exceeds 80. Same-creator dedup: 2nd entry at 0.5×, 3rd at 0.25× regardless of slot. recognizedVoice (1.2×) requires 2 cross-org 4★+ verifier cosigns via gaia dev evidence --cosign-with.

trustMagnitudeThresholds.description: Yggdrasil III Trust Magnitude grade thresholds. TM measures accumulated positive-scoring evidence only; fusion-recipe remains structural/provenance metadata at 0 TM and is excluded from diversity. S also requires an eligible independent witness.

S.plusRule: >=3 distinct positive scoring evidence types AND >=1 positive eligible independent witness from benchmark-result, verifier-attestation, or peer-review

A.plusRule: >=1 A-capable type present (pure github-stars-own at A is valid)

curationPrefill.description: Embedding-similarity thresholds for gaia-curate v2 prefill. Tunable via the Haiku dynamic-workflow loop. Cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2).

apexGate.description: 6★ apex gate configuration (RFC §11.12, amended by G7 delta §A). All 6 active predicates must be simultaneously satisfied. Two predicates are feature-flagged OFF until 2026-Q4 review.
apexGate.notes: crossOrgVerifierGte2 and systemWideCapRespected are implemented in passesSuiteApexGate() but return null (skipped) until re-enabled. System-wide cap enforcement lives in CI (meta-guard.yml I4), not in per-skill predicate evaluation. gaia promote rejects target_level==6★ at CLI layer; apex requires a manually-opened PR labeled apex-promotion with >=2 verifier approvals from >=2 distinct GitHub orgs.

4★.description: Origin-fusion path: 3+ skill fuses with at least 1 origin named skill (alternative to evidence path).

5★.description: Ultimate path: Platform capstones requires 5+ named prerequisites + Origin Fusion + 10k repository stars.

6★.description: Apex path: Reaching Apex rank (6★) requires satisfying all 6 active apex gate predicates simultaneously (RFC §11.12, amended by G7 delta §A). gaia promote rejects target_level==6★ at CLI layer. A PR labeled apex-promotion with >=2 cross-org verifier approvals is required. Legacy apexPath (minUltimateSkills/minUltimateLevel) is superseded by apexGate block above.

skillSuite.description: Fusion of 2 or more prerequisite skills where all component skills are installed altogether.
